title: Resume Best Practices: A Complete Guide for Showcasing Your Relevant 10%
description:
Is your resume showcasing your candidacy best?

Your resume offers a snapshot of your professional experience, but determining what to highlight and what to leave off can be tough. 

Do I add everything to my resume? What achievements should I showcase?

Not every job description is the same, and neither should your resume. 

That's why we're sharing some resume best practices to help you showcase the 10% of you that's 100% relevant to the role you're applying for. 

Check out a complete guide for showcasing your relevant 10%: https://www.tealhq.com/post/resume-best-practices
